completion:
Fail the test on the test record by placing an asterisks (*) next to the voltage reading.
3. Write out the result on the back of the cover slip (e.g., Hot/Ground reversed, Ground not present, Hot/Neutral Reversed, No Hot, No Ground, No H/N/G).

---

## Important for 240-volt appliances

A 240-volt appliance will always fail because they **do not have a ground, neutral, and hot pin** to plug them into a standard wall outlet. These appliances should have both a test sticker and a test record.

* Always write I240V/3P at the very top of the test sticker next to the date with a small arrow pointing downward or across to the stating on the sticker.
* The test record should also have I240V/3P (not I240V/2P) and
